visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with auburn hair, wearing a white mini dress and bright red cowboy boots, twirls and walks down a wide cobblestone pedestrian street in a European city. The street is lined with multi-story historic buildings with ornate facades and storefronts. (2) The scene transitions through a series of light-leak effects, showing her smiling broadly while looking back at the camera. (3) A young man with dark hair and a green-and-white zip-up jacket walks across a paved street with tram tracks, carrying a large mustard-yellow backpack. (4) A woman in a grey checkered coat is seen from behind, looking across a wide river (the Danube) at a large, grand neo-Gothic building (the Hungarian Parliament) under a cloudy sky. (5) The man and woman stand together on the riverbank, engaged in a cheerful conversation with the grand building in the background. (6) An overhead shot captures a narrow, sloped street with classic European architecture and trees on the sides. (7) The man is seen from behind, walking up the same narrow street while holding a white umbrella during a light rain. (8) On a stone balcony overlooking a sprawling city, the man stands alone, leaning against the railing. (9) The woman joins him on the balcony, and they pose together; she smiles with one arm raised while he stands with arms crossed, both looking toward the lens with the city skyline behind them.
